title: TranscriptEnvelope
description: THE versioned chat contract for GET /api/agents/:id/transcript — the single source of truth consumed by the live web dashboard, iOS/watch (OrchestraUltra), and the FABLE-5 shadcn web. Chat contract ONLY (the decision-surface grammar — approvals/menus/questionnaires — is a SEPARATE contract, the operator Q5). grammar_version 2 = additive envelope: items[] keeps the v1 flat shapes (plus additive summary/input_full/is_system on tool_use/text), and render_items[] adds server-paired render-ready nodes. Clients that don't support the stamped grammar_version major MUST degrade gracefully (render raw text), never mis-parse. Codegen: contract/transcript/codegen.mjs emits TS + Swift from THIS file — edit here, then regenerate; never edit generated files.

grammar_version.description: Bumped on any breaking item-shape change. Clients assert the major they support.

items.description: v1-compatible flat item stream (tool_result separate from tool_use). Kept for existing clients; new clients should read render_items.

render_items.description: Server-paired render-ready nodes: tool_result attached under its tool_use, empties dropped, spawn brief flagged. Clients render with a trivial node->view switch — NO client-side pairing or summarizing.

audience.description: ADDITIVE v2 (chat fold): user = drawn in the conversation (the operator's messages, the first and the closing reply of a turn he opened, and the closing reply of a job he set off); agent = folded into the strip between his message and the reply (tools, thinking, intermediate replies, every turn mail/hooks/lineage/init opened). The closing reply of the turn still running is provisional: a later reply in the same turn takes it over (the poll route re-tags; an SSE delta does not re-send older items, so a streaming client re-reads tags on its next snapshot).

exchange.description: ADDITIVE v2 (chat fold): uuid of the operator message this item belongs to (the latest one at or before it); absent before his first.

is_system.description: ADDITIVE v2: true on the first user text when it is the spawn/system brief (server rule: first user text AND (length > 800 OR starts with 'You are')).

queued.description: ADDITIVE v2 (queued-native-render, DEC-1789392107605493): true when this user turn is a still-pending phone/watch message merged from the msg_store hold queue (B1) — render a 'queued' chip; it resolves to the real turn on delivery. Older clients ignore this flag and render a normal user bubble.

model.description: ADDITIVE v2 (#458): the model that wrote this agent item (Claude: the entry's message.model, never "<synthetic>"; Codex: the model of the turn_context it ran under). Absent on user items and when unknown. Clients mark where it changes.

usage.description: ADDITIVE v2: tokens the model call that wrote this item spent, named and meant as in the OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions (gen_ai.usage.*). Once per model call: Claude on the first drawn item of each reply (Claude Code repeats a reply's usage on every one of its lines), Codex on the last agent item before its token_count. Summing it over items gives the true total. Absent when the source has no count (never guessed). A model call that drew nothing carries its tokens to the next agent item. Codex's arrives with its token_count after the response; the SSE tailer re-sends a snapshot when it lands on an item already sent.

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (both runtimes emit ISO strings).

input.description: Structured tool args for rich rendering. SIZE-CAPPED: each string value is truncated to 2000 chars with a trailing '…[truncated]'. When any value was truncated, input_full carries the full text.

summary.description: ADDITIVE v2: THE canonical server-computed one-line summary (max 120 chars, first line). Replaces web toolSummary() and the iOS summarize() — clients render it verbatim, never re-derive.

input_full.description: ADDITIVE v2: full multi-line text of the tool args (the code/diff a user sees on expand). Present ONLY when input was truncated. Format: per key in arg order, single-line values as 'key: value', multi-line values as '── key ──\n<value>', joined by newlines.

TokenUsage.description: Token counts in OpenTelemetry GenAI terms: each key is the gen_ai.usage.* attribute with the prefix dropped and dots made underscores.

input_tokens.description: gen_ai.usage.input_tokens: ALL input tokens, cached included (Claude: input + cache read + cache creation).

cache_read_input_tokens.description: gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens: the part of input_tokens served from cache.

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens: the part of input_tokens written to cache.

BatchEntry.description: One processed queued message inside a queued_batch (B2). Rendered as: agent · how-long-ago(sent_ts) · body.

agent.description: from_agent — who SENT the queued message (the entry's displayed name).

sent_ts.description: ISO-8601 created_at of the queued message; the client computes the relative 'Nm ago'. P2 adds the viewer's local wall-clock.

QueuedBatchItem.description: ADDITIVE v2 (queued-native-render, DEC-1789392107605493): one processed batch of agent-bound queued mail (B2). Collapsed-by-default, expands to the entries list (newest→oldest). Older clients: unknown kind is skipped gracefully (buildRows default:continue), so the batch simply doesn't render — no blank, no crash.
